# NoirMD — LLM Reference

> Quick reference for AI assistants. NoirMD is a markdown renderer + editor for React.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @noirmd/previewer react react-dom
# Editor (optional):
npm install @uiw/react-codemirror @codemirror/view @codemirror/state @codemirror/language @lezer/highlight
```

## Core Components

### NRpreviewer
```tsx
import { NRpreviewer } from '@noirmd/previewer';
import '@noirmd/previewer/markdown.css';

<NRpreviewer content="# Hello" tailwindCDN />
```
Props: `content`, `html`, `tailwindCDN`, `className`, `style`

### NReditor
```tsx
import NReditor from '@noirmd/previewer/editor';
<NReditor value={value} onChange={setValue} tailwindCDN />
```
Props: `value`, `onChange`, `className`, `debounceMs`, `tailwindCDN`

## Inline Syntax

| Syntax | Result |
|--------|--------|
| `**bold**` | **bold** |
| `_italic_` | _italic_ |
| `***bold italic***` | ***bold italic*** |
| `~~strikethrough~~` | ~~strikethrough~~ |
| `` `code` `` | `code` |
| `==highlight==` | ==highlight== |
| `!>spoiler<!` | hidden text |
| `%red%text%%` | colored text |
| `!~underline~!` | underlined |
| `\|[[icon]]\|` | Material icon |
| `[text](url)` | link |

## Block Syntax

### Headers
```markdown
# H1  ## H2  ### H3  #### H4  ##### H5  ###### H6
# ->Centered<-  ## ->Right->
## Title ##{.class #id}
```

### Code Blocks
````markdown
```javascript title="file.js"
code here
```
````

### Lists
```markdown
- Unordered item
1. Ordered item
```

### Tables
```markdown
| Col1 | Col2 |
|------|------|
| A    | B    |
```

### Blockquotes
```markdown
> Quoted text with **formatting**
```

### HTML Blocks
```html
<div class="my-class">
Markdown **inside** HTML works.
</div>
```

## Directives

General syntax:
```markdown
:::type {key="value"}
Content
:::
```

Short form: `:::note Quick Title` → `{title="Quick Title"}`

Shorthands: `.class` → `{class}`, `#id` → `{id}`

### Admonitions
- `:::note`, `:::info`, `:::warning`, `:::danger`, `:::greentext`
- Props: `title`, `icon`, `class`, `style`

### Cards
- `:::card` (static), `:::card-m` (modal), `:::card-b` (link)
- Props: `title`, `icon`, `image`, `class`, `style`, `url`, `batch`
- Slots: `#description`, `#content` (card-m only)

### Details
- `:::details {title="..." icon="..." defaultOpen="true"}`
- Collapsible section with custom state management

### Modal
- `:::modal {title="..." label="Open" icon="open_in_new"}`
- Opens dialog with markdown content

### Slide
- `:::slide {class="text-xl" interval="3000"}`
- Text carousel, one line per slide

### Wrapper
- `:::div`, `:::style`, `:::custom`, `:::raw`
- Generic wrapper, same as native `<div>`

## Styling System

- Tailwind CDN injection via `tailwindCDN` prop
- CSS variables: `--color-background-primary`, `--color-text-primary`, `--color-accent-primary`, etc.
- Theme: light/dark via `.dark` class on root
- Font families: `font-sans` (Inter), `font-mono` (Roboto Mono), etc.

## Parser Order

1. Headers → 2. Aligned paragraphs → 3. Code blocks → 4. Directives → 5. Images → 6. Tables → 7. Lists → 8. Blockquotes → 9. HR → 10. TOC → 11. HTML blocks → 12. Paragraphs
